title: I didn't like this pillow, not as advertised.
text: I didn't like this pillow, not as advertised.. Not 'firm' as advertised! Thin and lumpy stuffing. Also the box contained only one pillow out of the 2pc set advertised. Good news is Amazon quickly refunded me.
